note: Source workspace suites under src/app/(maestro)/source/preview/workspace/__tests__ that are deliberately NOT wired into CI. This directory's default is EXCLUDED by file: T-478 wired suites into .github/workflows/unit-suites.yml by exact path, so a file nobody enumerated is silently unrun. Before this list existed the only record of these three holds was a verdict in docs/architecture/t478-source-workspace-wiring-triage.json, which the CI coverage census does not read — so all three reported as untriaged and the directory held rank 2 on the governed-risk ranking with no untriaged work actually left in it. Adding an entry needs an owner, a reason, and the triage record the verdict is written in. Removing an entry is the fix.
howToClear: Each entry is held because the suite is a source-text scanner: it reads a source file and asserts substrings of it, so a comment carrying the same substring satisfies it and wiring it would buy a green check and no protection. Clearing an entry means rewriting the suite to execute the behaviour it describes, wiring it into unit-suites.yml by exact path, deleting the entry here, and amending the triage record to record the discharge — as T-764 did for page-tenant-routing.test.ts. check-source-workspace-quarantine.mjs re-measures the reason on every run: when a held suite stops reading source text the entry FAILS, so it cannot outlive its reason.
